title: Author partner-priority set(s) for agreed population/stage
context: Once a partner is secured (qpl-partner-001) and their population/stage/topic priorities are agreed, this task authors the QPL set(s) specifically requested by the partner. These are the sets that will be given to patients — the first true 'shipped' deliverables. The authoring process is identical to previous sets (style guide, allow-listed sources, provenance, UNCERTAIN: flags, disclaimer, support resources, dual sign-off) but is now scoped to the partner's stated priorities rather than general high-impact stages. All automated CI gates (qpl-a11y-001, qpl-license-001) must be green before reviewer handoff.
objective: Author one or more original QPL sets tailored to the partner's agreed patient population, journey stage(s), and topic priorities; apply the full pipeline (allow-listed sources, provenance, style guide, dual expert sign-off, automated CI gates); deliver sets ready for partner distribution.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one new QPL set file is present in sets/<stage>/<topic-or-general>/set.yaml, scoped to the partner's agreed population and journey stage(s) from docs/partner-brief.md
The set is original (original-authorship attestation present, no copyrighted QPL copied), grounded in allow-listed sources, with provenance on all framing claims
The verbatim disclaimer is present; verified support resources are referenced from support/resources.yaml
All UNCERTAIN: flags resolved before sign-off; dual expert sign-off recorded (clinician + advocate, each with COI declaration) in the review block and PR
All automated CI gates pass: schema validation (qpl-schema-001), license/provenance enforcement (qpl-license-001), readability/accessibility checks (qpl-a11y-001)
Sets are formatted for partner distribution (plain text, printable Markdown, or agreed format); Steward confirms sets are ready to hand to the partner
resources: docs/partner-brief.md (qpl-partner-001 — population, stage, topics, distribution format)
output: sets/<partner-stage>/<topic>/set.yaml (one or more files per partner brief); formatted distribution artifacts
